evidence: Each locale has a compact H1, one-sentence description, absolute URLs, key facts, and repository link.
The indexes point to localized homepages and full corpora without duplicating every passage.
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese wording matches each localized homepage.
Version, license, pagination threshold, privacy model, and conversion formats remain consistent.
No ranking guarantee, user count, speed claim, or unsupported compatibility claim was added.
All facts trace to the approved website corpus and public repository.

Live routes must return HTTP 200 after deployment.
